item.title: Antiferroelectric phase-field simulations via scale-invariant physics-informed neural operators
item.description:
یک اپراتور عصبی فیزیک‌محور چندشبکه‌ای، شبیه‌سازی میدان فاز آنتی‌فروالکتریک را با حفظ دقت و کاهش زمان از ساعت به ثانیه ممکن می‌سازد.
npj Computational Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 PI-MgNO is a physics-informed multigrid neural operator that surrogates antiferroelectric phase-field simulations. Its novelty lies in Landau free-energy constraints enabling drift-free autoregressive tracking and a thermodynamic error-healing mechanism. This yields scale-invariant, seconds-long simulations of double hysteresis loops with R² > 0.96, bypassing the quasi-static relaxation bottleneck and making high-throughput polycrystalline energy-storage microstructure optimization feasible.

💡 The novelty lies in using an imidazolium-based cationic covalent triazine framework as a bifunctional host/catalyst for both zinc-iodine and lithium-sulfur batteries. Its cationic sites regulate intermediate adsorption and conversion, suppressing shuttle effects. Significance: ultra-long 100,000-cycle life in ZIBs and high 1275 mAh g⁻¹ capacity in LSBs, demonstrating a common strategy for stabilizing high-capacity cathodes.

💡 In-situ polymerized 10 nm organic coating stabilizes air-sensitive Li5FeO4, blocking H2O/CO2 corrosion and enhancing Li+ kinetics. Coated Li5FeO4 retains 580 mAh/g after 100 h versus 171 mAh/g after 6 h uncoated. 💡 Single crystals of a twofold interpenetrated 2D covalent organic framework (CityU-64) were synthesized via dative B←N bonds, combining intra-layer interpenetration with inter-layer interdigitation for exceptional stability. item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This study reveals that electrolyte interfacial reactivity, not SEI composition, governs alloying anode pulverization. Low-reactivity electrolytes yield porous micro-grained bismuth anodes with thin SEI and ~99% capacity retention over 250 cycles; high-reactivity electrolytes cause nanoparticle pulverization and rapid failure. Validated in Sn anodes, this offers a general design principle for durable high-energy alkali-ion batteries.

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study reveals that TEMPO catholyte acidification proceeds via chloride oxidation and reversible proton release, independent of substituents. It identifies Hofmeister-type anion regulation as the key control, showing kosmotropic sulfate suppresses acidification versus chaotropic chloride. This enables 97.6% capacity retention over 300 cycles and broad lifetime gains, establishing electrolyte engineering for durable aqueous flow batteries.

💡 Inspired by lotus-leaf hierarchies, this work grows bifunctional MOF crystals in situ on cellulose acetate, combining micro-sized mechanical support with nano-sized polar sites for Li⁺ transport.
